FIELD MANUAL / START HERE

HOW TO SURVIVE.

Three moves separate you from your first champion. Watch for alliances, limited supplies, tactical encounters and a shrinking danger zone.

01

BUILD YOUR LINEUP.

Choose 2–100 competitors. Filter by sport and team, mix multiple eras of a legend, remove selections, or use Fill Rest to complete open slots without losing picks.

02

CHOOSE THE BATTLEGROUND.

Select one of four seeded arenas and a balance setting, then start. Abilities and terrain affect a deterministic fictional simulation, never real-world athlete rankings.

03

FOLLOW THE FIGHT.

Use the live top-10 lists to follow any contender, or activate the automatic camera. Track their health, supplies, eliminations and survival until one remains.

HOW DO RESULTS WORK?

The simulation evaluates game ratings, tendencies, resources, terrain and seeded outcomes. Using the same lineup, seed and settings gives the same results. A new seed creates a new hypothetical story.

CAN I LEAVE A MATCH?

Click the LL logo or the back-to-draft control during a battle. A confirmation dialog asks before an unfinished battle is ended.

WHERE ARE MY CHAMPIONS?

Completed matches appear in Champions. The saved history stays in this browser; it does not sync to an account, and the site does not claim to have global rankings.

ARE THE PERFORMANCES REAL?

No. Last Legend is a fictional, stylized battle game. It is not an assessment of anyone’s real-world behavior, violence, skill in a fight, or character.

LET'S PLAY ↗
LAST LEGEND / INDEPENDENT GAME PROJECT

A SPORTING UNIVERSE.
ONE SURVIVOR.

Last Legend brings unforgettable athletes, mascots and fantasy competitors into fictional survival scenarios. It's built for surprising outcomes and entertaining spectatorship, not predictions.

WHAT IS LAST LEGEND?

A free browser game where you create a draft, pick a battleground and watch animated encounters. Matches simulate 2–100 entrants from a roster that includes career editions and mascots.

DO I NEED AN ACCOUNT?

No. Guest play is available without an account or download. Finished match records are stored locally in your browser. Last Legend does not currently provide cloud-synced profiles or online multiplayer.

ARE ATHLETE AND TEAM LIKENESSES OFFICIAL?

No endorsement or affiliation with professional leagues, schools, athletes or rights holders is implied. Select team-era data and numbers have reference sources, but other design choices are provisional artwork. No official team marks are guaranteed.

WHAT DATA DOES THE GAME SAVE?

Completed-match records such as champions and elimination statistics are stored in this browser's local storage. You can delete them by clearing the website's stored data in your browser. No account-based history is offered.

IS IT SUITABLE FOR EVERYONE?

Current match presentation uses stylized, non-graphic fictional combat. Later content-intensity modes would need explicit audience controls and public-release review before launch.

ACCESSIBILITY & HELP

The game supports reduced-motion preferences, keyboard-accessible buttons, native confirmation dialogs and scrollable leaderboards. For gameplay instructions, visit How to Play.

ABOUT THE SIMULATION

STATS MATTER.
LUCK MATTERS TOO.

Every encounter uses sport-inspired ratings, tactical decisions, fatigue, terrain, game perks, and a seeded random roll. Same roster + arena + mode + seed produces an identical outcome. Change the seed to create a fresh story.

The real athletes' fictional game behavior is not a factual judgment of their personalities or real-world combat abilities. All ratings are estimates for entertainment. Only verified historical numbers are shown.
